name: retro
description: Use when a user completes a phase, sprint, milestone, or meaningful unit of work and needs a retrospective. Also triggers on `/retro` command. Generates honest, structured retrospectives from available project data (GSD planning files, git history, GitHub PRs/issues, user input). Adapts to any project — GSD-managed, plain git repos, GitHub-heavy workflows, or unstructured projects. Jira-aware: detects `.jira/` and redirects per-sprint retros to `/jira:retro` (the plugin owns the tight coupling to CONTEXT.md/VERIFICATION.md). Produces phase retrospectives, cumulative summaries, and stakeholder reports.
